name: view_duel_loading_two_rows
description: Loading a duel (design 5.6, M7): an Undertow party of two on a server (the lobby fake), one a side, starts, and the loading barrier lays its cards out in two rows as a race's, my side above and the rival's below with the gilt rule between them and a coverage row under each that counts its own Builder; no 'VS', no tips. The title names the mode, the map and its waves. Then the networked duel plays on the match scene with both hollows built from its start: my hollow the first, the duel's tray and bar, the party strip with my seat and the rival's under its caption; and MATCH_END ends it on the duel's results, one block per side.

steps.msg: two rows of cards: my side above, the rival's below
a gilt rule between the sides
a coverage row under each, counting its own side's Builder
the mode, the map and its waves

steps.assert: Game.is_duel() and Game.sim.seats.size() == 2 and scene.hollows_shown() == 2 and Game.my_hollow() == 0 and Game.seat == 1
steps.msg: the networked duel: both hollows, mine the first

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').visible and node('DuelBar').visible and node('PartyStrip').seats_shown() == [1, 2] and node('RivalCaption') != null
steps.msg: the duel's tray and bar; the party strip, my seat then the rival's

steps.assert: node('ResultsTitle').text == 'THE TIDE TOOK YOUR RIVAL' and node('ResultsPanel').team_lines()[0].begins_with('You ') and node('ResultsPanel').team_lines()[0].ends_with(': Sascha') and node('ResultsPanel').team_lines()[1].begins_with('Your rival ') and node('ResultsPanel').team_lines()[1].ends_with(': Ana')
steps.msg: the duel's results: the server's outcome, one block per side
